112	   writing: typography variants, the flex contract, theming/ladders,
113	   `Button view`, `Icon data`. Per-component traps live in the package's own
114	   `dist/docs`.

117	   (typically `tsc --noEmit`; for monorepos, the workspace's typecheck script).

126	     installed types.

132	     typecheck — but state this plainly in your reply: *"typecheck skipped by

138	     fills especially), narrow (~375px) and wide (~1400px) viewports for
139	     horizontal overflow, and empty / loading / error states.

141	## Hard rules
142	
143	- **`@gravity-ui/uikit` MUST be installed in every Gravity UI project.** It is
144	  the base component + design-token library every other `@gravity-ui/*` package
145	  builds on; without it components render unstyled. If `package.json` lacks it,
146	  stop and have the user install and configure it first (setup:
147	  `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/llms.txt`).
148	- **Read `package.json` before importing any `@gravity-ui/*` package.** Never
149	  assume a package is installed; never assume its major version.
150	- **Do not invent props or components.** Before using a component API you are
151	  not 100% sure of, check `rules/hallucination-traps.md` (ecosystem patterns)
152	  and the component's README in `dist/docs`. If still unsure, ask the user
153	  rather than guessing.
154	- **Never guess icon names** — they are hallucinated more often than not. To
155	  match an icon from a screenshot/photo/mock, run `scripts/icon-image-search.sh`
156	  (reverse image search). With only a description, look the name up on
157	  `gravity-ui.com/icons` or ask the user — do not invent one. Then pass it as an
158	  object (`<Icon data={CheckIcon} />`), never a string key. See
159	  `references/icons.md`.
160	- **Theming uses semantic `--g-*` tokens.** Never hardcode colors (`#fff`,
161	  `blue-500`); never hand-write `dark:` overrides. Full token tables live in
162	  `references/theming.md`; the cross-cutting traps (partial brand overrides,
163	  a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, controls on a brand background) live in
164	  `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
165	- **Required setup is package-specific** (style imports, `ThemeProvider`,
166	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
167	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.

172	already implied by the rules above; this section exists as an explicit
173	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.

176	  `<input>`/`<button>`, or look-alike component libs. Use the `@gravity-ui/*`
177	  package the task needs.

179	  read in Step 1, it does not exist — do not write `variant=`, `color=`,
180	  `name=` (on `Icon`), or a `header-3` variant. Use the documented prop or
181	  ask the user. See `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
182	- **Do not use the `/llms/<pkg>/llms.txt` "latest" alias as a fallback.** It
183	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
185	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.
186	- **Do not partial-brand.** Setting only `--g-color-base-brand` leaves
187	  selection, focus, links and contrast on the default accent — a mismatched
188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
189	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.

196

198	
199	- `references/package-routing.md` — offline snapshot of the ecosystem catalog
200	  (`gravity-ui.com/llms.txt`), refreshed each skill release. Used as the
201	  offline fallback in Step 0.
202	- `references/theming.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/theming.md`:

204	  themes, `uikit-themer`. The bundled copy may lag — read
205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.
207	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.
213	- `rules/hallucination-traps.md` — Incorrect/Correct pairs for the most
214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
216	  (partial brand overrides, a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, customization
217	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.

- **Боковая навигация:** `AsideHeader` из `@gravity-ui/navigation` с разделами «Главная», «Пользователи», «Заказы», «Настройки». Она сворачивается в иконки кнопкой у края. Текущий раздел хранится в состоянии. Роутера нет, пустые разделы показывают заглушку.
- **Таблица заказов:** `Table` из `@gravity-ui/table`, 60 тестовых заказов, шесть колонок и колонка с чекбоксами.
- **Выделение строк:** чекбоксы по строкам и в шапке. Чекбокс группы выделяет все её заказы, для этого подключён `useRowSelectionFixedHandler`.
- **Перетаскивание колонок:** за заголовки, через `ColumnReorderingProvider`. Колонка с чекбоксами тоже перетаскивается, закрепления слева нет.
